title: The Dark Plague
description: The mod add new mobs and items to the game
body:
Hi, I'm new here in the modding community and I'm working on a mod who add some new Zombies and maybe more after.

Going on a medieval/Zombie plague themed mod with more Mobs, items, structure and maybe faction Kingdom/Empire. I will work on it when I have time, I'm just starting to learn MCreator and blockbench on geckolib so sometimes there will be an update  just for some small change, to the model, the texture and fix some error.I will need more time for structure, item, new mob and more complex change.
do not hesitate to send some feedback, for now the mod is poor in content but I have some idea for it.
Currently in the mod
- 6 new undead mob: Walker, Crawler, Hunter, Plagued Enderman, Infected Wolf and Spitter;
- 5 weapons: 3 craftable and 2 drop from the new mob;
- 3 structures.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                 Link of the page mod on the website Mcreator:
https://mcreator.net/modification/106634/zcreatures
